flags.topic: OLBG is discovery, not fixture proof
flags.detail: OLBG exposes tip counts and market labels, not an official sporting record or a bookmaker quote. Every OLBG-only event is blank and withheld until an official competition source confirms it.
The queried PDC page exposed consent content rather than its calendar. Krzysztof Ratajski v Kevin Doets remains unconfirmed and unpriced.
The GAA page read did not name the two OLBG Gaelic Football club pairings. No outcome, handicap or probability is supplied for them.
WST semi-final time, NRL kickoff times, OLBG Today/Tomorrow labels, and F1 Track Time are displayed exactly as read. They are not converted to UTC where the source did not publish a timezone.
The queried Volleyball World, URC and EHF competition routes returned a not-found response. No substitute fixture list was guessed.
The GBGB query resolved to an old 2018 weather story, so this desk retains no current meeting, runner or race market.
